title: phaeanthus ebracteolatus
intro: Phaeanthus ebracteolatus, commonly known as Chinese angelica tree or angelica, is a plant species in the family Annonaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China and Southeast Asia, with a long history of use in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Phaeanthus ebracteolatus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, anti-anxiety, and anti-allergic effects.
